description: Find disputes on disputes.online that are open to bets, with each outcome's share of the stakes. Search by free text with query (a topic, a person, a team, an asset), filter by language, category, country and creation date, and sort by pool size, number of bets, newest or closing time. This is the tool for finding what people are predicting about something, what the crowd thinks the odds are, and what was opened recently — for yesterday's disputes pass yesterday's date as both created_from and created_to.

category_id.description: only disputes in this category or any category below it; ids come from list_categories

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the dispute is about, for example US

created_from.description: only disputes created at or after this moment, UTC. Either a day, 2026-10-07 (from the start of that day), or a full timestamp, 2026-10-07T12:00:00Z.

created_to.description: only disputes created at or before this moment, UTC. Either a day, 2026-10-07 (through the end of that day), or a full timestamp. For one day's disputes pass the same day as created_from and created_to.

lang.description: two-letter language code of the disputes to return: en, ua (Ukrainian), pl, de and so on. Defaults to en. Disputes marked all are always included.

offset.description: number of disputes to skip, for paging

query.description: free text to look for, for example bitcoin or trump impeachment. A dispute matches when every word occurs in its text or among its tags; fewer words find more. Leave empty to list everything.

sort.description: amount (largest pool first; the default), bets (most bets first), newest (most recently created first), closing_soon (betting closes soonest first), result_soon (result due soonest first)

name: search_disputes

betting_closes.description: when betting closes, RFC 3339 UTC; absent for a settled dispute

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the dispute is about

created.description: when the dispute was created, RFC 3339 UTC; absent for a settled dispute

dates_estimated.description: true when the event has no fixed date and the two dates are estimates

description.description: the full text, including how the result will be decided

language.description: language code, or all; absent for a settled dispute

outcomes.description: the possible results and how the stakes are split between them — for a settled dispute, how they were split when it was decided

bets.description: number of bets on this outcome

implied_probability.description: this outcome's share of all stakes, from 0 to 1; 0 when nobody has bet on the dispute yet

name.description: the outcome as its author worded it

payout_multiplier.description: what a winning stake is multiplied by at the current split of stakes; 0 when nobody has backed this outcome, and for a settled dispute

won.description: true for the outcome that won; only ever set on a settled dispute

result_due.description: when the result is due, RFC 3339 UTC; absent for a settled dispute

settled_at.description: when the dispute was decided, RFC 3339 UTC; present only for a settled dispute

status.description: new: no bets yet; in_process, hot, very_hot: accepting bets, by popularity; ready: betting closed, awaiting the result; done or dispute: decided but still being paid out or contested; settled: decided and archived, with the winning outcome marked

title.description: the question, taken from the first line of the description

total_staked_qot.description: pool size in QOT, the platform's internal currency — not dollars

url.description: the dispute's page on disputes.online; link this when citing

winning_outcome.description: name of the outcome that won; present only for a settled dispute that had a winner

offset.description: how many disputes were skipped before this page

total.description: number of disputes matching the request across all pages
